summary: V6.25.42 backend regression — 17 LIVE HTTP e2e tests against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + 5 prior auto-queue unit tests, all 22 PASS. Validated: (1) auto-queue intercept on PUT /api/characters/{id} and PATCH /folio inventory_state — player gets 202 + change_request, GM/admin bypass, gate-off allows player write; (2) non-inventory folio bucket (dnd_state) ALWAYS passes through; (3) GET /api/public/stats, /api/public/roadmap, /api/public/featured return clean JSON with no `_id` leakage; (4) GET /api/seo/sitemap.xml returns valid XML with /discover URLs, content-type application/xml; (5) GET /api/seo/og/{slug}.svg returns SVG for known slug, deterministic 404 for unknown; (6) POST /api/convert/preview-cost-balance returns source_budget/target_budget/delta object; (7) Admin moderation endpoints (/api/admin/flags, /audit, /showcases, /roadmap CRUD) all return 200 for admin and 403 for non-admin (Aurora). Note: review_request referenced `/api/conversion/preview` — actual route is `/api/convert/preview-cost-balance` with shape `source_budget/target_budget/delta` (not `source_cost/target_cost`).
